metadata.question: Did the town of Marovoay have higher water extent in January 27, 2020 than January 18, 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Town of Marovoay, Madagascar (approx -16.11, 46.64). Use a 10 km buffer AOI.
- Dates: Compare near 2017-01-18 and 2020-01-27. Primary: Sentinel-1 GRD (cloud-independent). Windows tried: ±5, ±15, ±30 days. Fallback: Sentinel-2 SR with cloud masking if S1 empty.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Sentinel-1: No cloud masking needed. Convert VV to dB and classify water with a fixed threshold VV_dB < -17.
- Sentinel-2 fallback: Use QA60 cloud mask. Compute NDWI and classify water NDWI > 0.3. Report cloud%.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If image collections empty after retries -> C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either date -> C2.
- If any computed metric returns null/NaN -> C3.
- Otherwise compare water area; strictly greater in 2020 => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper: getInfo as Promise
  const getInfo = (eeObj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v))));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const aoiCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([46.642, -16.111]); // Marovoay approx
  const aoi = aoiCenter.buffer(10000); // 10 km buffer
  const date1 = '2017-01-18';
  const date2 = '2020-01-27';

  const reduceScale = 1000; // per requirements
  const maxPixels = 1e9;

  // Helpers
  function s1Collection(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('resolution_meters', 10));
  }

  function toDB(img) {
    return ee.Image(img).select('VV').log10().multiply(10).rename('VVdB');
  }

  async function getS1Metrics(dateStr) {
    const base = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const windows = [5, 15, 30];
    const threshDB = -17;
    for (let w of windows) {
      const start = base.advance(-w, 'day');
      const end = base.advance(w + 1, 'day');
      const col = s1Collection(start, end);
      const size = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const mosaic = toDB(col.median()).clip(aoi);
      // Valid pixels count
      const validCount = await getInfo(
        mosaic.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: aoi,
          scale: reduceScale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels,
          bestEffort: true,
        }).get('VVdB')
      );
      if (validCount === null || validCount === undefined) {
        return { status: 'C3', line: `S1 ${dateStr}: Calculation failed (null count).` };
      }
      if (validCount === 0) {
        // Try next window; if last, report C2
        if (w === windows[windows.length - 1]) {
          return { status: 'C2', line: `S1 ${dateStr}: No valid pixels after masking.` };
        }
        continue;
      }
      const waterMask = mosaic.lt(threshDB).rename('water');
      const waterCount = await getInfo(
        waterMask.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: aoi,
          scale: reduceScale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels,
          bestEffort: true,
        }).get('water')
      );
      if (waterCount === null || waterCount === undefined) {
        return { status: 'C3', line: `S1 ${dateStr}: Calculation failed (null water).` };
      }
      const waterAreaHa = await getInfo(
        waterMask
          .selfMask()
          .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000))
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: aoi,
            scale: reduceScale,
            maxPixels: maxPixels,
            bestEffort: true,
          })
          .get('water')
      );
      if (waterAreaHa === null || waterAreaHa === undefined || isNaN(waterAreaHa)) {
        return { status: 'C3', line: `S1 ${dateStr}: Calculation failed (area null).` };
      }
      const line =
        `${dateStr} Source:S1 Img:${size} Win±${w}d ` +
        `ValidPx:${validCount} WaterPx:${Math.round(waterCount)} ` +
        `WaterHa:${waterAreaHa.toFixed(1)} ThreshDB:${threshDB}`;
      return {
        status: 'OK',
        line,
        metrics: {
          source: 'S1',
          images: size,
          window: w,
          validCount,
          waterCount,
          waterAreaHa,
          thresh: threshDB,
          cloudPct: null,
        },
      };
    }
    return { status: 'C1', line: `S1 ${dateStr}: No images found in ±30d.` };
  }

  function s2Collection(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lte('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
  }

  function maskS2Clouds(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).neq(0);
    const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).neq(0);
    const mask = cloud.or(cirrus).not();
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }

  async function getS2Metrics(dateStr) {
    const base = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const windows = [5, 15, 30];
    const ndwiThresh = 0.3;
    for (let w of windows) {
      const start = base.advance(-w, 'day');
      const end = base.advance(w + 1, 'day');
      const col = s2Collection(start, end);
      const size = await getInfo(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        continue;
      }
      const maskedCol = col.map(maskS2Clouds);
      const median = maskedCol.median().clip(aoi);
      const ndwi = median
        .normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8'])
        .rename('NDWI')
        .clip(aoi);

      const totalCount = await getInfo(
        ee.Image(1)
          .rename('c')
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: aoi,
            scale: reduceScale,
            maxPixels: maxPixels,
            bestEffort: true,
          })
          .get('c')
      );
      const validCount = await getInfo(
        ndwi.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: aoi,
          scale: reduceScale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels,
          bestEffort: true,
        }).get('NDWI')
      );
      if (validCount === null || validCount === undefined) {
        return { status: 'C3', line: `S2 ${dateStr}: Calculation failed (null count).` };
      }
      if (validCount === 0) {
        // Try next window; if last, report C2
        if (w === windows[windows.length - 1]) {
          return { status: 'C2', line: `S2 ${dateStr}: No valid pixels after cloud masking.` };
        }
        continue;
      }
      const waterMask = ndwi.gt(ndwiThresh).rename('water');
      const waterCount = await getInfo(
        waterMask.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: aoi,
          scale: reduceScale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels,
          bestEffort: true,
        }).get('water')
      );
      if (waterCount === null || waterCount === undefined) {
        return { status: 'C3', line: `S2 ${dateStr}: Calculation failed (null water).` };
      }
      const waterAreaHa = await getInfo(
        waterMask
          .selfMask()
          .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(10000))
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: aoi,
            scale: reduceScale,
            maxPixels: maxPixels,
            bestEffort: true,
          })
          .get('water')
      );
      if (waterAreaHa === null || waterAreaHa === undefined || isNaN(waterAreaHa)) {
        return { status: 'C3', line: `S2 ${dateStr}: Calculation failed (area null).` };
      }
      const cloudPct =
        totalCount && totalCount > 0 ? (100 * (1 - validCount / totalCount)) : null;
      const line =
        `${dateStr} Source:S2 Img:${size} Win±${w}d ` +
        `ValidPx:${validCount} WaterPx:${Math.round(waterCount)} ` +
        `WaterHa:${waterAreaHa.toFixed(1)} NDWIth:${ndwiThresh}` +
        (cloudPct !== null ? ` Cloud%:${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}` : '');
      return {
        status: 'OK',
        line,
        metrics: {
          source: 'S2',
          images: size,
          window: w,
          validCount,
          waterCount,
          waterAreaHa,
          thresh: ndwiThresh,
          cloudPct,
        },
      };
    }
    return { status: 'C1', line: `S2 ${dateStr}: No images found in ±30d.` };
  }

  async function processDate(dateStr) {
    // Try S1 first
    const s1 = await getS1Metrics(dateStr);
    if (s1.status === 'OK') return s1;
    if (s1.status === 'C2' || s1.status === 'C3') return s1; // Can't fix with fallback if S1 had images but invalid after masking
    // If S1 had no images (C1), try S2
    const s2 = await getS2Metrics(dateStr);
    if (s2.status === 'OK') return s2;
    // Prefer more informative code among C2, C3, C1
    if (s2.status !== 'OK') return s2;
    return s2;
  }

  try {
    const res1 = await processDate(date1);
    const res2 = await processDate(date2);

    // Print concise evidence lines
    console.log(res1.line);
    console.log(res2.line);

    // Handle failure cases
    const failurePriority = { C3: 3, C2: 2, C1: 1 }; // choose highest severity to report
    const failures = [res1, res2].filter((r) => r.status !== 'OK');
    if (failures.length > 0) {
      // Pick the most severe failure
      failures.sort((a, b) => failurePriority[b.status] - failurePriority[a.status]);
      console.log(failures[0].status);
      return;
    }

    // Both OK: validate numbers
    const w1 = res1.metrics.waterAreaHa;
    const w2 = res2.metrics.waterAreaHa;
    if (w1 === null || w2 === null || isNaN(w1) || isNaN(w2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Final comparison: Is 2020-01-27 > 2017-01-18?
    const answer = w2 > w1 ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    // Syntax/method/memory or other runtime errors
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
